Our Roofing Services

Roof repairs, new roofs, flat roofs, tiling and slating, chimneys, lead work and guttering for homeowners across Sussex.

Roof RepairsLeaks traced, tiles replaced, ridges re-pointed and emergency repairs. New RoofsStripped, re-felted and re-tiled or re-slated, usually in 2 to 3 days. Flat RoofsFelt, single ply, GRP fibreglass and EPDM rubber, usually in 1 to 2 days. Guttering, Fascias and SoffitsNew uPVC gutters, fascias and soffits, usually in 1 to 2 days. Chimney RepairsStacks repaired and rebuilt, re-pointing, lead flashing and caps. Tiling and SlatingSlipped tiles and slates replaced, ridges re-pointed, slopes re-tiled. Lead Flashing and ValleysWorn valleys renewed and new lead dressed around stacks and walls.
Moss CleaningMoss cleared from roofs. Ask us when we quote.
Gutter CleaningGutters and downpipes cleared. Ask us when we quote.
